traj_tests.note: Deterministic oracle. Weights 1/3/5 by severity, negatives subtract; component weight = mean of the absolute test weights (58/16 = 3.625). Channel value is the pytest score, with the reproducer gate and the decisive repaired floor applied by score.py in test.sh, then floored at 0 for the ledger.

rubric.note: LLM-judged semantic channel, scored by _judge/rubric_judge_cli.py over JUDGE_WIRE (openai | anthropic | gemini). component weight = mean of the absolute criterion scores in rubric.json (42/10 = 4.2). Channel value is rubric_breakdown.json 'score' = rc * (1 - rb). DROPPED from both sums when no judge key is configured or the judge fails, so the reward falls back to traj_tests alone.

reward_rule: reward = max(0, sum(component.weight * component.value) / sum(component.weight)) over graded components that produced a value, clamped to [-1, 1]. rubric share when both channels score = 4.2 / (3.625 + 4.2) = 0.5367.
